brief_summary: The overall aim of the project is to determine whether or not exercise influences cardiovascular or nervous responses to meal ingestion in individuals with insulin resistance or type 2 diabetes.
brief_title: Acute Cardiovascular and Metabolic Effects of Exercise Training in Individuals With Insulin Resistance

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Insulin resistant: diagnosed with pre-diabetes or fasting blood glucose \>/= 100 mg/dL
* T2D: diagnosed by primary care physician
* BMI: less than 43 kg/m2
* Age: 30-65

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smoking
* Insulin use (other than once daily)
* Underlying conditions that limit ability to exercise safely
* Recent weight gain or loss (\>5% of body weight in 3 months)
* Physically active (\>30 min aerobic exercise, 2 d/wk)
* Recent (\<3 mo) changes in medication use or dose
* Uncontrolled T2D (HbA1c\>10%)
* Advanced retinopathy or neuropathy
* Pregnancy

official_title: Physical Inactivity and Insulin Resistance in Skeletal Muscle

primary_outcomes.measure: Insulin Sensitivity After 5-7 Days of Exercise
primary_outcomes.time_frame: baseline and 24h after 5-7 days of exercise

primary_outcomes.measure: Blood Flow in Response to Oral Glucose Tolerance Tests
primary_outcomes.time_frame: pre and 24 hours post 5-7 days of exercise
